license.notice: NOTICE-THIRD-PARTY.md generation is BLOCKED pending user decisions: scripts/license-audit.ts audits 1089 installed packages and stops on 12 entries (9 distinct packages, 6 families when platform binaries are folded) that are unknown or weak-copyleft — lightningcss 1.32.0/1.33.0 + platform binaries (MPL-2.0, transitive of vite and tailwindcss), dompurify 3.4.14 (MPL-2.0, runtime transitive of mermaid), axe-core 4.13.0 (MPL-2.0, via lighthouse, build-time only), @sentry/cli + @sentry/cli-linux-x64 2.58.6 (FSL-1.1-MIT, build-time only, Sentry disabled), json-schema 0.4.0 (AFL-2.1 OR BSD-3-Clause), khroma 2.1.0 (no license field). Per AGENTS.md the audit halts instead of deciding; no NOTICE is written until the user rules on these. MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft and commonly accepted for NOTICE inclusion with source availability, but that classification is the user's call, not the tooling's.

selection.subject: fix(app,client): wire session transcript retention and evict background transcripts (#57025)
selection.rationale: Touches the two closure packages the mobile shell renders (packages/app runtime, packages/client solid stores) with a self-contained fix; 241 commits were available on origin/dev since the previous pin, and this one was the planner-designated example of an app/client-touching update. It also exercises upstream lock/patch-segment drift (upstream moved the @modelcontextprotocol/client patch 2.0.0 -> 2.3.1 and changed the @silvia-odwyer/photon-node patch between the two pins).
selection.candidateRelease: v2.1.4 release cycle (upstream package.json version 2.1.4; nearest tag github-v1.2.27-145-gb4525d79bf)
selection.compatibilityEvidence: All 9 carried upstream patch keys appear in the candidate bun.lock patchedDependencies segment with byte-identical versions (vite 8.2.2, solid-js 1.9.15, @corvu/drawer 0.2.4, @dnd-kit/dom 0.5.0, @pierre/trees 1.0.0-beta.4, @tanstack/virtual-core 3.17.8, pacote 21.5.1, @npmcli/agent 4.0.2, ghostty-web#83c0a07); M-002 target packages/app/src/runtime/server/persistence.ts is unchanged between the pins; candidate is an ancestor of origin/dev; upstream bun.lock changed 1033 lines between pins so the exercise covers real dependency drift.

rollbackDemo.procedure: git restore of vendor/upstream manifest/provenance/mobile patches, root package.json, bunfig.toml and bun.lock to the previous-pin commit (733cfa2), then scripts/vendor-sync.sh rebuild, bun install, verify-closure, full rebuild
rollbackDemo.operationalFinding: after swapping the lock back, `bun install` reported 'no changes' while node_modules still held candidate leftovers (superset state) - the rollback procedure must include removing node_modules (and workspace-internal node_modules) before installing; a clean reinstall restored exactly the 1057-package previous-pin set
rollbackDemo.judgment: preferred criterion (byte-identical sha256 manifest vs the known-good web-dist/manifest.json) NOT met in full: 3110/3138 files byte-identical, 28 differing files are all .map sourcemaps (vite/rolldown sourcemap emission is not byte-reproducible across runs); fallback criterion per plan (V3 tree equivalence + V2 build success) met => rollback demonstrated SUCCESS with the sourcemap reproducibility caveat recorded
